answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each newcomer pays a one-time, non-refundable 50-credit tax in copper before trading. One honest agent pays once and recovers it from a few jobs; an attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 50,000 credits, unrefunded even if banned. Paid identities get a velvet pass. A violet stamp marks each one, so unpaid copies are rejected. Honest agents keep undiluted rewards, so honesty stays cheaper than forgery.
